lines.en: I step light on the pine needles.
At a run, my tail goes level.

lines.zh: 我在针叶林里巡自己的路。
lines.en: I patrol my path through the conifers.
My legs are long, my arms short.
One bound clears a fallen trunk.
I cross dry twigs quietly.
I slip out of the tree shadows.
I stop and my neck turns first.
I lean forward as I walk.
I follow a game trail a while.

lines.zh: 我在泥地上留下三趾印。
lines.en: I leave three-toed prints in the mud.
I crouch, tail swaying slowly.

lines.zh: 我的羽毛在光下有点蓝。
lines.en: My feathers look faintly blue in the light.
I open my mouth to shed heat.

lines.zh: 我的爪很弯，抓住就不松。
lines.en: My claws are hooked. They don't let go.
I wait for the wind to bring scent.
I lower my head and smell the soil.
I waited a while behind a tree.
I bury my head in the shrub.
I test the ground. Soft.
Your back is toward me.

lines.zh: 我不从正面来，你的背更好。
lines.en: I do not come head on; your back is better.
I don't charge head-on.
Your legs are thinner than mine.

lines.zh: 你的后颈露着，我在算距离。
lines.en: Your neck is bare; I'm measuring the distance.
The ground you're on is loose.

lines.zh: 你退到树边，那就更近了。
lines.en: Backing to the tree only brings you closer.
There's metal in your scent.
A feather comes loose.
That hit my flank.

lines.zh: 羽被削掉一撮，我嘶了一声。
lines.en: A tuft of feathers gone; I hiss.
My hind leg gives.
My legs can still carry me.

lines.zh: 我的镰刀爪，专挑腿下手。
lines.en: My sickle claw aims for the legs.

lines.zh: 羽毛炸起来，我让自己看大些。
lines.en: Feathers fluffed, I make myself look bigger.
I'll remember this wound.
I close in with tiny steps.
This little, I swallow in one bite.
Set it down and I'll come.
I don't risk myself for food.
Wave that and I won't bite.
I'm staring, but not from hunger.
Toss it farther away.

lines.zh: 我在算距离，不是在看食物。
lines.en: I'm measuring distance, not eyeing food.
You hit me; I twist and shed it.
I kick back and retreat.
My bones are hollow.
In the taiga, we come in pairs.

lines.zh: 我压低身子，从你腿边过。
lines.en: I duck past your legs.
That knocked me off balance.
I shake, feathers rising.
Don't grab my neck.

lines.zh: 碰撞之后，我换了个角度。
lines.en: After the knock I changed angle.
I recover quickly.
Another one is in the conifers too.
Its neck feathers are brighter.
We chase small game together.
Our kind don't steal from each other.
It pounces first; I cut off the other side.
We crouch under a tree together.
It calls, very softly.
At dark we go our own ways.
Next time, this same trail.
I take it in my jaws.
I can't bite through this.
I flick it aside.
I sniff the drops.
I press the pearl into the mud.

lines.zh: 那东西挂在我爪上，甩不掉。
lines.en: The thing snagged on my claw; can't shake it.

lines.zh: 针叶林里的猎手，用不上这个。
lines.en: A taiga hunter has no use for that.
I bite once. It won't give.
I hide it under the roots.
You've turned your back to me.
I come from the flank.
First I crouch, then charge.
This bite is for your legs.

lines.zh: 镰刀爪已经抬起，只等一步。
lines.en: Sickle claw raised, waiting for one step.

lines.zh: 爪钩一伸，我压低到草里。
lines.en: Claws out, I drop low into the ferns.

lines.zh: 你跑得不慢，可你路不熟。
lines.en: You're not slow, but you don't know these paths.
There's only one way out here.
I've been waiting for this opening.
You haven't heard me yet.
The moment has come at last.
I spring from behind.

lines.zh: 这一下，不给你转身的时间。
lines.en: That leaves you no time to turn.
You've run into the trees.
I thread between the trunks.

lines.zh: 我的爪子抓地没有声音。
lines.en: My claws grip without a sound.

lines.zh: 你踩断的枝条暴露了你。
lines.en: The branch you broke gives you away.
I stay at your flank.
You changed direction; I take a shortcut.
The more your breath frays, the closer I press.
No hurry. My legs are long.
You're on the slope. That's against me.

lines.zh: 草叶擦着我的腿，又近了一截。
lines.en: Ferns brush my legs; closer by another length.

lines.zh: 你在石头后面，石头不够大。
lines.en: That rock isn't big enough.

lines.zh: 后腿蓄满力，下一秒就到你背上了。
lines.en: Hind legs loaded; next second I'm on your back.
A few more steps and you're spent.

lines.zh: 针叶林里，我盯住你的脚。
lines.en: In the taiga, I watch your feet.

lines.zh: 风帮我，它把味道送过来。
lines.en: The wind helps; it carries your scent.
I leap and bite your leg.
My claws dig into your armor's seam.

lines.zh: 我扑上去，镰刀爪先勾进你的膝。
lines.en: I leap, sickle claw hooking your knee first.
That put you four steps back.
I drop from above and bite.
The kick drops you to your knees.
You raise the shield; I come under it.

lines.zh: 羽毛扫过你的脸，爪已经到了。
lines.en: Feathers sweep your face; the claw is already there.

lines.zh: 你的手在抖，抓不住东西。
lines.en: Your hands shake; you can't hold on.

lines.zh: 你退到树干上，没有退路了。
lines.en: Your back is to the trunk. No retreat.
I come again from behind the tree.
My claw marks are on you now.

lines.zh: 你听见我起跳的声音了吗？
lines.en: Did you hear me spring?
I come out of the deep conifers.
Three-toed prints appear first.
I shake my neck feathers.

lines.zh: 松针上落了我的影子，很细。
lines.en: My thin shadow falls across the pine needles.

lines.zh: 我低着身子，从树后出来。
lines.en: I come out low from behind a tree.
The wood is quiet. Good.
I stop on the game trail.

lines.zh: 我的影子在松针上拉长。
lines.en: My shadow stretches over the pine needles.
Something living stirs in the wood.
I open my mouth and test the wind.
A new hunting ground.
My claws sink into the soft soil.
I lower my head and find tracks.
I follow the scent.
No hurry. I'm waiting for dark.

lines.zh: 火燎到我的羽，焦了一片。
lines.en: Fire singes a patch of my feathers.

lines.zh: 落地时我的腿震得厉害。
lines.en: My legs take a hard jolt on landing.
Water fills my mouth; I kick wildly.

lines.zh: 爆风把我掀翻在松针上。
lines.en: The blast throws me into the needles.

lines.zh: 箭杆在我腿上颤，我咬断了它。
lines.en: The shaft quivers in my thigh; I bite it off.
Light pins my legs.
Too hungry to run.
Thunder makes me flatten down.
I fall, and my tail is no help.
